Alex —

Thanks — phased approach makes sense and is workable. To answer your questions:
- For MAP acceptance we usually accept management-level evidence for the pilot (configs, policies, excerpts of control logs). A signed SOC 2 report is great but not always required to start pilot; we’ll mark any outstanding items that require the full attestation.
- Phased DPA signing is acceptable: pilot DPA to enable evaluation, then full DPA for production (we’ll include a clause that the pilot agreement converts to prod DPA within X days of go-live).

Ben / Irene — can you review the attached SOC 2 checklist and CAIQ export and confirm what we’ll need from Railway to mark the MAP gate as satisfied? I’m proposing we only require the following for pilot acceptance:
1) Management evidence for the 12 SOC 2 controls we listed in the MAP (logs, control owner sign-off) by Jun 14
2) CAIQ answers for the 8 control families in-scope by Jun 14
3) DPA marked up by Railway and initial Redwood redline returned by Jun 18

If anything there is a blocker, call it out and we’ll gate the MAP accordingly.

Best —
Hannah
